title: hylocereus stenopterus
intro: Hylocereus stenopterus, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Cereus or Queen of the Night, is a species of cactus in the genus Hylocereus. This plant is known for its vibrant flowers that bloom only at night and have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. Hylocereus stenopterus is believed to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and regulating blood sugar levels. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are thought to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects.
